published.citation: Zieba et al. 2022, dayside temperature of the joint fit to the Spitzer 4.5 µm and K2 phase curves, 2049 +362 -359 K: 2049 +/- 362 K, https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.00370

temperature.note: Its day side's brightness temperature is measured in secondary eclipse at 4.5 µm (Spitzer IRAC and Kepler) and nobody has imaged it, so the color is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
temperature.chosen: the paper's two-temperature model with reflected light fitted beside the heat; the larger of its two errors is kept
